title: Algebraicity conjecture for Ramsey multiplicity constants
statement:
For graphs $H_1$ and $H_2$, let $c(H_1,H_2)$ denote their balanced Ramsey multiplicity constant.

**Algebraicity conjecture.** There do not exist graphs $H_1$ and $H_2$ such that $c(H_1,H_2)$ is transcendental.

The conjecture asserts that every Ramsey multiplicity constant is algebraic, while allowing that some such constants may be irrational. No resolution is given here.
source_name: Elena Moss and Jonathan A. Noel, “Off-Diagonal Ramsey Multiplicity”, arXiv:2306.17388 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.17388

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2023).
